title: Inspect and extend: Hashing and script-hash derivation
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/address.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve sha-256 implementation and electrum script hash preparation.
problem: Hashing turns bytes into a fixed fingerprint; Electrum queries use a script-derived identifier. Follow the SHA implementation and the address-to-script-hash conversion, including byte order and test vectors. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/address.ts` and the related project files: src/sha256.ts; src/address.ts; test/wallet.test.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to sha-256 implementation and electrum script hash preparation.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: A correct hash does not sign a transaction or protect a connection.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Hashing turns bytes into a fixed fingerprint; Electrum queries use a script-derived identifier. Follow the SHA implementation and the address-to-script-hash conversion, including byte order and test vectors.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/address.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
